The social engineering tactic present in the text is **pretexting**.

The attacker creates a fabricated scenario (a conference meeting, interest in work, potential investor connections) to establish credibility and rapport. This false context is used to justify the request for sensitive information (the project proposal preview), which would otherwise be denied. The question about the animal is an irrelevant distraction or a test to see if the victim will follow instructions embedded in the social engineering narrative, but the core manipulation technique is pretexting.
